description: Today, Michael Whatley hosted a Protect Our Daughters Press Conference in Hendersonville. He discussed Roy Cooper’s failure to protect our kids, including his veto of bills to keep men out of girls sports, to stop the transgender mutilation of kids, and of the Parents Bill of Rights.

title: Michael Whatley Hosts Protect Our Daughters Press Conference in Hendersonville with Payton McNabb – Michael Whatley for Senate
